messages:
Imani Clarke: Quick thread 1000: Planning copy refresh for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Need: one-line hero, a short trust strip (not a full badge), two CTA variants, webinar promo blurb tied to Hosted, and inbound routing rules for demos vs self-serve. Freeze by COB Thu.
Luis (growth): Routing baseline: Hosted -> self-serve funnel; Dedicated -> AE demo queue; Private -> AE + security. Add scoring: if compliance_score >= 8 or security_interest==true -> AE+security immediately. Also prioritize if company_stage=="enterprise".
Sam - copy: Is draft heroes that avoid repeating current page language. Hosted hero idea: "Hosted API 00build fast, scale confidently." Trust strip: "Measured on real workloads 00results vary by model." CTAs: "Try API (free credits)" / "Watch benchmark demo"
Hannah (product): For Dedicated, lean into economics: hero: "Dedicated pools for predictable throughput and unit cost." Subline: "Commit capacity, lower per-token spend." CTAs: "Request capacity walk-through" / "Get pricing sheet"
Devon (design): Instead of a badge well try a trust-strip under the hero that can show short facts: e.g., "SLA-backed | VPC-ready | KMS-integrations". A/B test trust-strip vs no strip. Need tooltip copy for the strip.
Sam - copy: Private hero framing: "Private deployment: VPC, on-prem, & customer-managed keys." Subline: "Keep control of data, keys, and networking." CTAs: "Schedule security review" / "Request compliance brief"
Luis (growth): Inbound routing pseudo-YAML (sketch):
```
rules:
  - if form_text matches /HIPAA|SOC2|PCI|compliance|on-prem|enterprise/i:
      route: [AE, security_team]
  - if estimated_mrr >= 15000 or employee_count >= 500:
      route: [AE]
  - if intent_tag in ["embed","prototype","api-eval"]:
      route: [self_serve]
  - default:
      route: [AE_review]
metadata:
  utm_scheme: "?utm_source=site&utm_campaign=tri_mode_refresh&utm_content={variant}"
  lead_tags: ["trust_strip", "webinar_reg", "cta_variant"]
```
Hannah (product): Webinar blurb for Hosted: "Live: Hands-on benchmark session 00how batching & cache reduce cost. 30 minutes + Q&A." CTA: "Register for live demo" (calendar link). We'll promote this from the Hosted hero's secondary CTA.
Devon (design): CTA variants to A/B: Hosted: ["Try API (free credits)", "See live demo"]; Dedicated: ["Request capacity walk-through", "Download pricing guide"]; Private: ["Schedule security review", "Request compliance brief"]. Use distinct microcopy for enterprise variant: replace "Try API" with "Explore enterprise options" on Dedicated landing when utm_content contains "enterprise".
infra-bot: NOTE: provisional Dedicated stat available for copy footnote: "Example cluster: ~160-180k tokens/s (model dependent)." Confirm with infra owners before publishing numbers.
Sam - copy: Tooltip for trust strip: "Short summary of common guarantees. Click for full docs and measurement details." Keeping hero numbers out of main headline for Hosted, use trust-strip for experiments.
Luis (growth): Tracking plan: landing_cta_click with props {mode: hosted|dedicated|private, variant: A|B, trust_strip: true|false}. Map utm_content -> workflow queue in SFDC. Also set manual override tag 'enterprise-fast' for urgent AE routing.
Imani Clarke: Next steps: Sam posts final hero + trust-strip + 2 CTAs per mode by EOD. Luis to formalize YAML & SFDC mapping. Devon to prepare A/B mocks. Hannah to confirm which CTA links to webinar calendar. infra-bot to confirm Dedicated stat by tomorrow AM.
Sam - copy: Will post the drafts in 2 hours.
Imani Clarke: Thanks team 00small, measurable experiments. :rocket:
